summary: Duck closed all positions (BTC +20%, DOGE +20%, ETH flat) ahead of US election due to personal reasons (sick baby, vacation mindset) rather than bearish conviction. Both hosts remain structurally bullish on BTC with key support at 62k and resistance at 70k. ETH forming ascending triangle but underperforming badly vs BTC - hosts note sentiment is overly bearish. Solana approaching key trendline resistance around 180; breakout would be very bullish. Cat coins (POPCAT, MEW) making new highs while dog coins consolidate. Hosts emphasize Bitcoin dominance as retail cannot easily onboard into meme coins.
key_takeaways: BTC: Bullish above 62k, very bullish above 70k - monthly and weekly structure looks excellent despite consolidation
Duck closed positions for lifestyle/election reasons, not bearish conviction - made 20% on BTC, 20% on DOGE, 0% on ETH
ETH ascending triangle at resistance (2.7-2.8k) but BTC pair continues to bleed - contrarian long setup building
SOL is leveraged BTC trade - if BTC breaks out, SOL likely breaks 200 and targets 250-400
Election outcome matters short-term (few weeks) but not long-term for crypto direction
